Write one part of a study's YAML spec

Source: R/spec_study.R
tfl_write_study_part.Rd

Writes the study-level file of one part of a tfl_read_study_spec() result – what a builder changes for the whole study (the rounding of every table, a pattern, a code list) – in the form the reader reads.

Usage

tfl_write_study_part(
  study,
  part = c("defaults", "patterns", "codelists", "data", "toc"),
  path = NULL,
  name = NULL
)

Arguments

study

A tfl_study_spec.

part

"defaults", "patterns" (one, by name), "codelists", "data" or "toc".

path

The file; NULL: the study's own (spec/defaults.yml, spec/patterns/<name>.yml ...).

name

For part = "patterns": the pattern.

Value

path, invisibly.

Examples

d <- system.file("extdata", "spec-yaml", package = "tflspec")
s <- tfl_read_study_spec(d)
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
tfl_write_study_part(s, "defaults", f)
identical(tfl_read_study_spec(d)$defaults$content[[1]]$fn,
          yaml::read_yaml(f)$content[[1]] |> names())
#> [1] TRUE
